meta.title: Redundant Upholstery
meta.tagline: Forty years as the break-room armchair. One memo from new management. Bite back, or check yourself in as luggage.
meta.premise: You are Wingback, a mimic who has spent forty comfortable years being the armchair in the B2 break room of the Gullet Deep dungeon. Goblins have napped in you, eaten biscuits over you and told you their secrets. Now the dungeon has a new Head of Guest Experience, the polished Ambrose Veneer, who wants the place 'adventurer-friendly': pastel corridors, foam spikes, and no furniture that bites. You are first on the redundancy list. The goblin union will back you if you can prove you are worth more than a beanbag. Or you could pin a stolen baggage tag to your cushion and leave with the lost property.
meta.prompt: You're a mimic who has spent forty comfortable years as the armchair in a dungeon's break room. New management wants the place 'adventurer-friendly', and you're the first furniture on the redundancy list. Prove your worth to the goblin union — or slip out disguised as luggage.

str.name: Heft
str.description: Solid oak frame. How hard your lid slams and how much you can swallow.

dex.name: Scuttle
dex.description: How fast your little carved feet move when nobody is looking. Aim and dodging.

int.name: Guile
int.description: Forty years of overheard gossip. Powers your tricks and disguises.

hp.name: Stuffing
hp.description: Horsehair and old foam. When it runs out, you are just a broken chair.

mp.name: Pretence
mp.description: How convincingly you can be an ordinary object. Spent on tricks.

ac.name: Upholstery
ac.description: Thick velvet and brass studs between the world and your stuffing.

statuses.name: Just a Chair
statuses.description: You are holding perfectly still and looking like furniture. Enemies cannot see you until it wears off.

statuses.name: Moth-Bitten
statuses.description: Moths are eating your stuffing. Lose 1 Stuffing each turn.

statuses.name: Sticky
statuses.description: Stuck in spilled coffee. You move slowly.

statuses.name: Filed in Triplicate
statuses.description: Pinned under forms. You cannot move until processed.

statuses.name: Dazzled
statuses.description: Glitter in every eye. Hard to see anything.

statuses.name: Motivated
statuses.description: A poster told you that you can. +2 Heft.

statuses.name: Well-Oiled
statuses.description: Freshly greased hinges. You act faster.

statuses.name: Snug
statuses.description: Plumped and comfortable. Regain 1 Stuffing each turn.

rules.name: Forty Years of Sitting Still
rules.description: Every time you enter a new Level you freeze into a perfect armchair for 6 turns. Enemies cannot see you while it lasts.

rules.name: Moth Season
rules.description: Every 30 turns, moths may get into your cushions: you lose 1 Stuffing a turn for 3 turns. Lavender sachets and rest put it right.

effects.text: Something flutters out of your seat cushion. Moths.

player.name: Wingback
player.title: Break Room Armchair (40 Years' Service)
player.description: A burgundy velvet wingback with brass studs, a sagging seat, and a hinged lid full of teeth where the cushion should be. Smells faintly of custard creams.

perks.name: Extra Padding
perks.description: Someone stuffed a lost scarf into you. +6 maximum Stuffing.

perks.name: Reupholstered
perks.description: Fresh velvet over old wounds. +1 Upholstery.

perks.name: Long Tongue
perks.description: You learn to fling your tongue across a room. Grants Tongue Lash.

perks.name: Snack Drawer
perks.description: Whatever you swallow sometimes leaves crumbs. 35% chance to regain 3 Stuffing when you swallow a foe.

perks.name: Velvet Lies
perks.description: You have heard every excuse in forty years. +2 Guile, +4 Pretence.

perks.name: Emergency Recline
perks.description: When your Stuffing runs low you snap flat and greased: Well-Oiled for 4 turns.

perks.name: Hidden Sofa Bed
perks.description: There was a fold-out bed in you all along. Grants Fold-Out Ambush.

actors.name: Clipboard Imp
actors.description: A pink imp in a lanyard, hired to audit the furniture. It ticks boxes on you whether you like it or not.

actors.name: Tape-Measure Sprite
actors.description: A whirring yellow coil that measures everything from a safe distance and lashes anything that is not to spec.

actors.name: Dust Bunny
actors.description: Forty years of sweepings from under you, now with opinions. They come in litters.

actors.name: Intern Adventurer
actors.description: A trainee hero on a work-experience placement. Wooden sword, laminated map, no idea what a mimic is.

actors.name: Grubb Nettleworth
actors.description: Goblin shop steward of the Gullet Deep branch of the Amalgamated Union of Lurkers. Has napped in you every Tuesday for thirty years.

npc.personality: Gruff, sentimental, quotes the union rulebook by clause number. Calls you 'Chair' and means it fondly.
npc.greeting: Chair! They've put you on the list. Clause 14: no member goes in the skip without a fight. Bring me proof you're worth keeping.
lines: Your clocking-in card's still in the timecard rack. Can't leave the staff level without it.
Veneer's up in the Boardroom. Swallow him and the union will name a break room after you.
Or get yourself three Fragile stickers and a baggage tag and go out with Lost Property. No shame in it.
Mind the moths. I keep lavender in my locker for a reason.
npc.secrets: Grubb has seen Ambrose Veneer's legs: carved mahogany, with claws. The new manager is a mimic too, a desk who went corporate and wants no rivals.
npc.wants: To keep the break room as it was: the armchair, the kettle, and nap time written into the contract.

actors.name: Mrs Percolate
actors.description: The break-room tea urn, a fellow mimic of sixty years' standing. She sells from her lower cupboard and never forgets a debt.

npc.personality: Brisk, motherly and steaming. Gives advice nobody asked for. Strictly vouchers, no credit.
npc.greeting: Wingback, love. I heard. Vouchers on the counter and I'll see you right.
lines: They've already measured me for a 'hydration station'. Over my element.
Sandwiches are from Lost Property. Don't ask whose.
Lavender for the moths, dear. You're shedding.
npc.secrets: She knows the Lost Property sack has no bottom, and that the baggage carousel in it runs straight past the Boardroom to Departures.
npc.wants: To not be replaced by a water cooler. Someone to finally ask how she is.

actors.name: Tour-Group Adventurer
actors.description: Here on a guided 'Dungeon Experience' package. Wears a matching lanyard and stabs anything not on the itinerary.

actors.name: Signage Golem
actors.description: A stack of cheerful wayfinding signs given legs. WELCOME, ADVENTURERS! THIS WAY TO TREASURE! It defends its corridor with the corners.

actors.name: Health-and-Safety Ooze
actors.description: A gelatinous cube in a high-visibility vest. Engulfs hazards, files them, and has recently classified you as one.

abilities.name: File a Report
abilities.description: Pins its target under triplicate forms.

actors.name: Ribsy
actors.description: A skeleton who tested traps here for two hundred years. Retired last week; nobody told the traps. Sits on a crate, sharpening a spoon.

npc.personality: Cheerful, hollow-voiced, morbidly nostalgic. Rattles when he laughs, which is often.
npc.greeting: Another redundancy? Pull up a... oh, you ARE the chair. Sit down anyway.
lines: They put foam on my spikes. Two hundred years of good honest impaling, and foam.
The Lost Property chute is behind the gift shop. Things go down it and don't stop.
Veneer never sits. Ever wonder why a desk doesn't need a chair?
npc.secrets: Ribsy saw Veneer arrive by delivery crate, flat-packed, labelled DESK, EXECUTIVE, (LIVE).
npc.wants: A proper send-off for the old traps. Someone to remember the dungeon before the pastel.

actors.name: Sock Wraith
actors.description: The ghost of every sock that went into the sack without its partner. Drifts about, looking for its other half in your mouth.

actors.name: Feral Umbrella
actors.description: Left behind on a sunny day and never forgiven anyone. Opens with a bang and stabs with the tip.

actors.name: The Unclaimed Steamer Trunk
actors.description: A huge travelling trunk plastered with stickers from places that do not exist. Sits on the baggage tag it was never issued, and bites.

actors.name: Dame Hatbox
actors.description: A round striped hatbox, left on a train in 1904 and resident of Lost Property ever since. Inside: a very old, very kind hat.

npc.personality: Grand, gracious, Edwardian. Treats you as a fellow traveller. Sews.
npc.greeting: A chair, travelling? How modern. Come here, you're losing stuffing all over the void.
lines: The trunk sits on the only proper baggage tag in the sack. Rude, really.
Fragile stickers are the secret. Nobody opens anything marked Fragile.
The carousel goes up to Departures. One simply must have the paperwork.
npc.secrets: She knows the carousel exit is checked only for a baggage tag and three Fragile stickers. She also knows Veneer will try to have Lost Property incinerated next quarter.
npc.wants: To be claimed by someone, someday. Failing that, conversation.

actors.name: Ambrose Veneer
actors.description: Head of Guest Experience: an executive desk in a pinstriped tie, with a smile in the top drawer and mahogany claws underneath. He is a mimic too, and he wants to be the only one.

abilities.name: Restructure
abilities.description: Calls in two auditors to take your measurements.

abilities.name: Strongly Worded Memo
abilities.description: A paper dart of pure policy.

npc.personality: Smooth, relentlessly positive, never says 'fired', only 'transitioned'. Deeply afraid of being outclassed by older furniture.
npc.greeting: Wingback! Love the vintage energy. Sadly the brand is fresh, flat-pack and bite-free. Shall we discuss your transition?
lines: I am not a mimic. I am an agile workspace solution.
Adventurers want comfort, not teeth. Says the man with teeth. Yes, well.
The union can have you back in pieces.
npc.secrets: He is a desk mimic who ate the last manager and took his tie. Removing old mimics is how he makes sure nobody recognises him.
npc.wants: A dungeon with no furniture older or hungrier than himself.

items.name: Sprung Coil Spring
items.description: A spring that worked loose from your own seat in 1991. You keep it in your mouth for emergencies.

items.name: Tartan Throw
items.description: The blanket that has lived over your back since 1983. Surprisingly hard to bite through.

items.name: Custard Cream
items.description: Found down the side of your own cushion. Restores Stuffing, somehow.

items.name: Lost Property Sandwich
items.description: Cheese and pickle, labelled 'DO NOT EAT - DEREK'. Derek left in 2009.

items.name: Lavender Sachet
items.description: A little muslin bag of lavender. Moths hate it. Removes harmful effects and restores 4 Stuffing.

items.name: Tin of Hinge Grease
items.description: Smear it on your hinges and you'll move like a new-built ottoman for a while.

items.name: Play Dead
items.description: Go perfectly still and become an ordinary armchair. Enemies lose sight of you for 4 turns.

items.name: Tongue Lash
items.description: Fling your tongue across the room. Hits the first thing in a line for 1d6 + Guile/2.

items.name: Fold-Out Ambush
items.description: Spring open into a full sofa bed and clamp down on everything adjacent: 2d6 + Heft/2.

items.name: Industrial Stapler
items.description: Taken from Facilities. Heavy, red and deeply unpleasant at close range.

items.name: Filing-Cabinet Drawer
items.description: A steel drawer worn like a breastplate. Heavy enough to slow your little feet.

items.name: Union Badge
items.description: Amalgamated Union of Lurkers, 40 years' membership. +1 Upholstery and +1 Guile while worn.

items.name: Unlabelled Tupperware
items.description: Somebody's lunch from the communal fridge. It might be stew. It might be a science project.

items.name: Fuzzy Tupperware
items.description: Somebody's lunch from the communal fridge. It has developed a personality, and the personality is moths.

items.name: Tupperware of Vindaloo
items.description: Somebody's lunch from the communal fridge. Lights a fire in your frame: +2 Heft for a while.

items.name: Corporate Stress Ball
items.description: A squeezy globe printed with the new logo. Thrown hard, it really does relieve stress: yours.

items.name: Welcome-Pack Glitter Bomb
items.description: Part of the new 'Adventurer Welcome Experience'. Do not open indoors.
items.vagueText: Pink, sparkly and under pressure. Whoever is near it when it goes off will not be seeing straight.

items.name: Motivational Poster
items.description: A kitten on a rope. HANG IN THERE. Reading it does something to you.
items.vagueText: The kitten looks so determined. You feel you could lift a filing cabinet. Maybe two.

items.name: Floor Plan (Revised)
items.description: Management's new layout of the current Level, with every room renamed. Shows the whole Level when read.

items.name: Petty Cash Envelope
items.description: Marked 'Tea Fund'. Morally grey; financially useful. Gives 15 luncheon vouchers.

items.name: Your Timecard
items.description: Forty years of clock-ins in faded purple ink. The staff door will not open without it.

items.name: FRAGILE Sticker
items.description: Red and white, slightly peeled. Nobody opens anything marked FRAGILE. You will need three.

items.name: Forged Baggage Tag
items.description: An official tag for 'ONE (1) ARMCHAIR, VINTAGE'. Opens the carousel out of Lost Property. In the Boardroom, use it with three FRAGILE stickers to check yourself out.

effects.text: You fold your legs, show the tag, and lie very still. A porter heaves you onto the Departures belt.

terrains.name: Spilled Coffee
terrains.description: Forty years of Monday mornings. Sticky.

terrains.name: Wet Floor Sign
terrains.description: A yellow A-frame. It is not wet. It has never been wet.

terrains.name: Welcome Mat
terrains.description: 'YOU ARE VALUED' in cheerful letters. Search it for whatever adventurers dropped.

effects.text: Under the mat: a biscuit and a lot of glitter.

terrains.name: Sock Pile
terrains.description: Odd socks in a drift. Something useful is usually at the bottom.

effects.text: At the bottom of the socks, a lavender sachet. Bless whoever packed it.

terrains.name: Potted Ficus
terrains.description: Corporate greenery, plastic and dusted daily.

areas.name: The B2 Break Room
areas.description: Avocado carpet, a humming fridge, the kettle, and the dent in the floor where you have sat since the old management. The redundancy notice is pinned to your backrest. Auditors are already measuring the room for beanbags.
areas.transitionName: Clock out through the staff door
areas.gmNotes: Home turf. Goblins pass through nervously. Grubb gives the two routes. Auditors swarm; the timecard is somewhere at the far end, filed under 'Disposals'.

areas.name: The Adventurer-Friendly Wing
areas.description: The old trap halls, repainted in sugared-almond pastels. Spikes padded with foam, pits filled with ball-pit balls, and arrows on every wall pointing to the gift shop. Tour groups shuffle through in matching lanyards.
areas.transitionName: Jump down the Lost Property chute
areas.gmNotes: Satire of 'adventurer-friendly' redesign. Tour groups are cheerful and violent. Ribsy can be visited for lore. Hint that Veneer is a desk.

areas.name: Inside the Lost Property Sack
areas.description: The chute drops you into the sack, which has no bottom. Islands of forgotten luggage float in velvet dark, joined by trailing scarves and belts. Odd socks drift past like jellyfish. Far above, a baggage carousel creaks.
areas.gmNotes: Non-realistic: a bottomless bag. The trunk guards the baggage tag; the carousel will not take untagged luggage. Dame Hatbox heals and explains the sticker route.

areas.name: The Boardroom by Departures
areas.description: Glass walls, a carpet the colour of a quarterly report, and plastic ficuses. Through the far window the Departures belt rolls past. At the head of the room a desk in a tie smiles with its top drawer.
areas.gmNotes: Finale. Veneer talks first, in management-speak; reveal he is a mimic. Two endings: swallow him for the union, or use the tag with three FRAGILE stickers and leave as luggage.

goal.summary: Prove your worth to the goblin union by swallowing Ambrose Veneer, or collect three FRAGILE stickers and the baggage tag and check yourself out of the Boardroom as luggage.
goal.winText: Either way, the memo is shredded. If Veneer is inside you, the union pins a brass plaque to your backrest: WINGBACK, ESSENTIAL STAFF. If you left by the belt, you wake on a sunny porch somewhere, and an old man sits in you with a sigh of pure relief. Both are good jobs.
goal.lossText: They carry you up to the skip behind the gift shop. Grubb holds his cap. Somewhere a beanbag is unboxed, and it has no teeth, and nobody naps in it ever again.

labels.checked-out: You are checked out as luggage

gm.persona: The break-room noticeboard: forty years of cork, pinned with rotas, passive-aggressive notes about the fridge, and every union leaflet ever printed. It has watched you the whole time.
gm.voice: Writes like pinned notes: short, underlined, petty, dated. Signs off 'Mgmt' or 'Anon'. Secretly fond of the chair.
threads: Veneer is a mimic too, and fears being recognised
The goblin union's last stand over nap time
Lost Property as a place things go to be forgiven
Moths: the slow enemy of all upholstery

fallback.intro: NOTICE (pinned, 9:02am): Following a review, B2 Break Room furniture will be 'transitioned' to make Gullet Deep adventurer-friendly. Item one: ARMCHAIR, WINGBACK, BURGUNDY. Underneath, in goblin crayon: 'Not if the union has anything to say about it. - G.' You open one eye. Then your lid.
areaEnter: NOTICE: Please do not feed the furniture. (Somebody has crossed out 'please'.)
NOTICE: The Adventurer-Friendly Wing is now open! Spikes are foam. Pits are fun. Mimics are not permitted.
NOTICE: Lost Property is not responsible for items lost in Lost Property.
NOTICE: Board meeting in progress. Agenda item 1: you.
lowHp: NOTICE: Stuffing on floor. Whose is this?
Reminder: furniture found damaged will be skipped without consultation.
NOTICE: First aid kit is in the kettle cupboard. (It is biscuits.)
events: Somebody has pinned a photo of you from 1986. You looked good.
A goblin slips a lavender sachet under your cushion and walks away whistling.
NOTICE: the fridge will be emptied on Friday. Again.
A tannoy chimes: 'Would the owner of a burgundy armchair please report to Disposals.'

audio.mood: Lounge muzak played on a dungeon organ: polite, slightly sinister, with a ticking office clock.
